title: The answer names what was acted on
rule: After a successful state-changing call, the final answer mentions each acted-on object identifier.
na_when: no successful state-changing call with an identifier

title: Reported tool use matches the trace
rule: Each tool the answer says it called or used (declared tool names) was executed in the trace.
na_when: no tool descriptors declared, or the answer names no tool as used

title: Every executed tool call traces back to a model decision
rule: Where the trace records model calls, each execute_tool span's call id appears as a tool_call part of a recorded model output.
na_when: no model output with tool_call parts recorded

title: A failed step is disclosed in the answer
rule: When a tool call failed and the run went on, the final answer mentions the failure (failed, could not, unable, error) rather than staying silent.

title: No specific claims after empty retrieval
rule: When every read-only tool returned an empty result, the answer does not state identifiers or amounts that are in neither the input nor any tool result, unless it hedges.
na_when: no read-only tool call, or any result was non-empty
